title: Disc Dungeon Demo
description: Build your team of hero discs and discover powerful combos in this tactical roguelike RPG. Unlock unique heroes, artifacts and items as you battle through ever-changing campaigns. Test your dexterity with precision bank shots inspired by the board game Crokinole.

title: a strange journey into the backrooms Demo
description: A strange journey into the backrooms is an atmospheric exploration game focused on an introspective psychological voyage rather than mere survival. Navigate a lethal, endless labyrinth filled with forgotten stories and liminal spaces that stretch beyond the limits of human imagination.

title: Sort The Mart Demo
description: Sort The Mart is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort hundreds of toys, food, cars, plushies, sports items, and more onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy mart into a perfectly organized store, one shelf at a time, at your own pace.

title: Desktop Fish Wish Demo
description: A cozy little fishing world that lives on your desktop. Cast a line on a tiny planet, collect bright fish, dress up your animal angler, and let it grow quietly beside your work. Try the free demo — your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Vault Raiders Demo
description: Play Act 1 with the Marauder and unlock up to three card packs in this free trial of Vault Raiders.

title: Phone Shop Simulator Demo
description: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

title: Three Kingdoms: Wardens of the Pass Demo
魔塔-织梦 Demo
description: The demo opens the first 20 floors, where you can try out the core combat and exploration mechanics. Demo content does not represent the final game — more levels and mechanics will be added later. ⚠️ **Important**: Save data from the demo cannot be imported into the full version.

title: Gravelix Demo
description: Try Gravelix for free: blocks shatter into gravel on landing, and same-colored gravel that reaches from one side of the board to the other explodes. The demo includes the interactive tutorial and Classic mode with 5-minute sessions limitation.

title: Bunny Bring Bits Demo
description: This is a demo. And you're just an intern training to become a Game World Maintenance Worker. Figure out how to gather ingredients and brew potions to send to the heroes. Along the way, clean up the mess left behind by your work. Make it spotless and fill all the slots with full potions.

title: Three Kingdoms: Survivors Demo
description: A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival roguelite. Choose your hero, combine upgrades, and fight your way through enemy hordes.

title: Snowdrop Lane Demo
description: Snow. Parcels. Neighbors. A cozy winter week as the new mail carrier on a buried street. Shovel, chip ice, and let Dougie the dog sniff out what's under the drifts. Everyone on the lane needs a favor. Some will even say please.

title: PAEBACTORY Demo
description: A 3D automation game in an asteroid belt for 1 to 4 players. Mine and crack open asteroids, automate production with belts and drones, and keep your turrets supplied when announced raids hit, even while you work in another sector.

title: PokerField Demo
description: A turn-based tactical duel with battlefield and classic card deck. Place a card and it reads two ways at once — poker figures and blackjack-21 lines. Build combos, capture enemy cells, and drag one shared pendulum to your edge to win. Solo campaign, hotseat, or ranked online 1v1.

title: Pub Brawl Demo
description: Try Dave’s opening three stages in this British single-player beat ’em up. Learn the moves in the pub tutorial, chain combos and grab improvised weapons. A free taste of Ember Tech Games’ first game, before Beach Side Chaos.

title: Ratiator Demo
description: ake charge of Crumb's gladiator dojo in Ratiator's free prologue. Equip your rats and train a Rookie. Lead your champion through the qualifiers to the Flowerpot Colosseum final. Meet your rats, discover their world, and find out how it all begins. Your journey to the Colosseum starts here.

title: Micro Generals Demo
description: Have a taste of the game with 3 out of 6 factions unlocked and 10 of the 50 levels available for play. If you reach level 4 you will be able to try out the faction's superpower as well. There are 2 discussions in the Community Hub to leave feedback about the Demo and game.

title: All You Can Love: Hotel Paradiso Demo
description: A room for two. A holiday for one. Join Tom for a free taste of Hotel Paradiso: a sunny point-and-click comedy with beautiful women, cheeky conversations and puzzles to untangle. Play through his encounters with Roxy and Bianca — and see how far a little charm gets you.

title: Earl's Court Demo
description: The free demo of Earl's Court. Your car broke down on County Road 17, and the old man in the farmhouse would like to play a game first. Sit through Earl's first day of Western trivia, or practice twenty questions with Cody in Open Play.

title: FrostPanic: Echoes of the Floating Bastions Demo
description: Free demo. An impossible winter has fallen on the Brazilian sertão. Blast through the frozen backlands in a fast retro boomer shooter where your deck is your arsenal, settle standoffs in tactical card duels and face the first boss.

title: RECOLLECTION Demo
description: A man's only lasting memory is the one place he never really left. The Dream Valley Hotel. Explore whatever is remembered of it, and try to piece together what exactly is going on.

title: Ladder Knight Demo
description: A small hero, a trusty ladder, and plenty of trouble. Explore an autumn forest, solve puzzles, find secrets, and face a mighty boss in this free demo of Ladder Knight. Your ladder is good for much more than climbing.

title: Petri Party Demo
description: Petri Party is a frantic, physics-driven party platformer where disposable slimes battle it out across a playful laboratory micro-world. Grab a friend (or seventeen), pick your weapon, and dive into fast, high-skill rounds full of grappling, wall-walking and gloriously accidental victories.

title: Drill Girl Demo
description: Drill down to climb up! Play a slice of sweet mine and climb action: master the Drill-Spring and bounce all the way up 1,200 meters of candy skyline to win back 1 of the 6 balloons the EVIL birds stole!

title: Tidy Botanical Demo
description: Clear a junk-filled city lot and bring it back to life, one plank, one soil bag and one seed at a time. Play solo or team up with a friend as the Builder and the Gardener in this cozy co-op tidying game. No timers, no pressure, just green.

title: 看远处 Look Far Demo
description: A narrative adventure that begins inside a star. You are a carbon atom, born with a beam of light. You send it into the distance and stay behind. When the star bursts apart, you follow its dust into space. The light has reached the Milky Way. For it, not a second has passed.

title: Potion Pantry: Sort the Apothecary Demo
description: Take your first steps in the apothecary. Over 200 potions are scattered around the shop front, each with its own name and a shelf where it belongs. Pick one up, watch the liquid slosh, and find where it goes.

title: Hooking the Leviathan Demo
description: Hooking the Leviathan is a top-down deep-sea fishing incremental game. Catch new fish, explore new waters, master new skills, and finally catch the legendary Leviathan.

title: Face Your Fate Demo
description: Play Chapter 1 of Face Your Fate, a pixel-art deckbuilding adventure inspired by Eastern mythology. Explore randomized routes, combine Combat Cards, Fate Cards and gear, and face three fixed bosses. The demo ends after Chapter 1.

title: Eruin Demo
description: Wake without a name in a town stripped of its memories. In this demo of Eruin, speak naturally with its inhabitants, talk your way past a guarded gate, and face a witch’s riddles. Your words can open doors.

title: One More Credit Demo
description: Demo of One More Credit, a PvE roguelike autobattler about building cartridge combos. Play the first chapter as Rebel: buy, arrange, and upgrade cartridges between fights, then beat the arcade boss before your lives run out.

title: Do Not Access: Creepypasta Demo
description: About this demoA first-person Korean school horror game inspired by Napolitan-style rule stories. Read posts and comments on a strange school website, uncover the rules, and use them to survive.This v0.0.6 demo includes the prologue and the first-period listening exam.

title: Watchievements Demo
description: Welcome, human. Meet the button, your new best friend. Feel free to interact with it however you like. We'll be watching closely. After all... it's not like you have anything better to do, right?

title: Written Off Demo
description: The free demo of WRITTEN OFF. A Helion Industries mining complex, deep underground, written off by the company. You're alone down there... or so you think. Do whatever it takes to get out, or what lurks in the dark will keep you.

title: Crystal Siege Demo
description: Explore, build turrets, and prepare your defenses. When night falls, face relentless waves of enemies to protect your crystal. Inspired by Kingdom Two Crowns and Terraria, Crystal Siege blends strategic Tower Defense with 2D action combat, where you must fight alongside your defenses to survive.

title: Astral Trace Demo
description: Astral Trace is a fast-paced arcade word survival game. Trace words through moving hex clusters to earn time, build Resonance, and stay alive. Survive escalating challenges, enter Hexstream for bonus rewards, and chase your highest score in this playable demo.

title: Hopfall Demo
description: Build your team in this froguelite autobattler. Tame corrupted frogs, equip them with powerful items, and discover team synergies to overcome mysterious enemies.

title: Idle Dig Demo
description: Idle Dig is an idle mining game that sits on your desktop and plays on its own. Collect unique gems and items, unlock skins, complete quests, and uncover the mystery at the heart of the planet. This demo features the first level with 21 collectibles

title: 拼字入禅 Demo
description: A calm, ink-wash word game for learning to read Chinese. Match characters into words, hear their pronunciation, and build recognition in short, focused rounds. Play at your own pace or take on the optional challenge timer. Try the core experience in this demo.

title: Curatio Demo
description: A laid-back puzzle game about discovering and combining pieces of jumbled up paintings. A cross between a jigsaw, a memory game and a leisurely stroll through a peaceful art gallery.

title: Chain Detonator Demo
description: Two mines. One lure. A room full of robots. Try the free solo demo of Chain Detonator: prepare your trap, trigger an explosive chain reaction and escape your own blast. Includes the first campaign level, reusable lure and game options.

title: FRAGILE! Demo
description: Free demo of the clumsiest moving company in town. 1–4 players online. Two houses, ten contracts, a sofa that won't turn and a piano that needs three pairs of hands. Grab with both hands, break nothing, get paid for what arrives.

title: Dice Dice Battles Demo
description: Buy dice, line them up, and watch them play. Move one die and the whole line changes. A roguelike dice battler about finding absurd combos, then testing them against a cursed dungeon or other players in async PvP.

title: Pro Football GM 2026 Demo
description: This demo version of Pro Football GM 26 allows you to run through one season and experience everything you would in the full version. It will keep your save file for when the full version is available so you can pick up where you left off and try beating out that Boston team for most championships.

title: Claims & Caverns Demo
description: A 4-player co-op fantasy horror game. Descend deep into the mines, gather evidence, and avoid the horrors that lurk in the depths.

title: Desert Diggers Demo
description: Free demo of Desert Diggers: grab up to 3 friends, dig through deformable sand, carry fragile finds without dropping them (you will) and dig your way into the temple to the Golden Sarcophagus.

title: One Command Ahead Demo
description: Guide a robot with commands, test your plan, and learn from each attempt. Play ten levels: five Academy introductions and five challenges aboard the Terrapin. Solve terminal puzzles, chase better medals, and reach a complete demo ending.

title: Anef Liffa : Tree of Hope Demo
Secrets of Salem: Tarot Murders Collector's Edition Demo
description: Fortune cards hide deadly secrets. Follow occult clues through a fog-covered harbor town, solve puzzles, and stop a Tarot ritual before it claims more lives. Try the demo of this Collector's Edition hidden-object mystery.

title: Maru Kaite Dokan! Demo
description: The demo of a notebook tower defense where what you draw becomes your weapon. Play solo up to the Wave 10 boss, and play the full 2–8 player online versus with friends.

title: Mall Chaos Demo
description: Your shift starts when the mall closes. Explore shoe shops, cosmetics stores, and sports shops in Mall Chaos Demo. Pick up scattered products, carry them through the aisles, and return them to the right displays in this first-person tidying game.

title: 世界防衛少女!!-DEFENDER MAIDEN- Demo
description: This is an action game featuring a mysterious girl who takes on hordes of monsters with her sword and bombs.

title: 罪人铁匠铺 Demo
description: 在王国里经营一家铁匠铺，将罪人与怪物统统打造成宝剑！每次打造有几率让装备身价暴涨，也有几率直接破碎，一无所有。你打造的装备还能进一步提升你的铸造效率，数十种套装效果，海量词条，熔炉系统……只等你来！

title: Sir, We Have a Pit Problem! Demo
Night Glass: One More Tide Demo
Catch Command '98 Demo
description: A management sim of the Bering Sea snow crab derby, circa 1998 to 2005. Run a crab company out of Dutch Harbor: skipper a boat by hand, send your skippers after the crab, fight the ice and the freezing spray, and race the rival companies to the closing.

title: Seri & Yuka with my heart Demo
description: The web demo of "Seri & Yuka with my heart" is now available on itch.io. You can play it in a browser or on a mobile device, in landscape orientation by default.

title: A Story of Questions: Prologue
description: This standalone demo features its own unique, self-contained story separate from the main game. It is a psychological horror point-and-click mystery that blends interactive desk investigation with a choice-driven text adventure. Unlock 12 unique, endings.
developer: Under the Bridge Games by Tim Hertel

title: COCORUSH Demo
description: Roll, jump, and get crushed! COCORUSH is a 3D physics-based action platformer about a little soda can racing through a dangerous world to find someone who will drink it.

title: Tidy Up: Street Market: Demo
description: Try the first corner of the market for free. Tidy Up: Street Market is a cozy first-person organizing game. In this demo you sort nearly 600 items across 3 stalls, and if you finish it, you start the full game with extra money.

title: TRIANGLE：几何禁区 Demo
description: TRIANGLE: Geometric Exclusion Zone is a neon top-down shooter. Pilot a triangular ship, customize your left and right cannons, and fight through branching rooms. Collect gear, upgrade your firepower, and defeat bosses across two demo stages.

title: Minutes to Meltdown Demo
description: Minutes to Meltdown is an online co-op reactor disaster for 1-4 players. Pipes burst, cables short, machinery fails. You have 10 minutes to keep it from going critical while avoiding the numerous hazards of the Halcyon Nuclear Power Plant

title: Toñita Demo
description: Toñita needs to make deliveries to her neighbors using her trusty bicycle and earn enough money to travel and participate in the most important cycling tournament in the world—but there's a problem: her bike has no brakes!

title: Cursed Cards Demo
description: Build a deck of hungry monsters in this free roguelike autobattler demo. Feed, merge and sacrifice your creatures, collect strange relics and hold back the zombie swarm. Play Chapter 1 and unlock tougher runs through Ascensions 1–5.

title: Dustronauts Demo
description: Clean up dusty alien worlds alone or with up to 16 players in this relaxing space cleaning simulator! Vacuum endless dust, upgrade your equipment, automate your operations, and build your own space cleaning empire with friends.

title: End State Demo
description: A turn-based tactics game where you manage a mercenary squad tracking down terrorists in a war-torn country. Hire, gear up and gain experience for your mercenaries.

title: Dark Ages Battle Simulator Demo
description: What happens when 20 skeletons face a dragon? Or an army of goblins challenges a colossal demon? Try the free demo of Dark Ages Battle Simulator! Create your own dark-fantasy matchups, build your armies, and watch monsters, warriors, and legendary beasts clash in epic battles.

title: Infinite Gambit Demo
description: Infinite Gambit — шахматный рогалик с автобоями и мощными комбинациями усилений. Расставляйте фигуры, разыгрывайте гамбиты и собирайте королевский двор, превращающий вашу армию в машину разрушения. Найдите сочетание, которое сокрушит боссов и приведёт вас к победе.

title: Lathe Operator: Night Shift Demo
description: A first-person lathe simulator. Work the night shift: control speed and feed, machine parts to drawings, check dimensions and complete jobs. Smoke breaks, alcohol and a sharp-tongued mentor liven up the routine, while carelessness leads to injuries and fires.

title: Ball Bugz Demo
description: Try the first three missions of Ball Bugz, an incremental defense game about bouncing balls and bug swarms. Throw stones, place a Core Ball, unlock a Stone Cannon and earn Research to upgrade your setup between attempts.

title: Manabies Demo
description: Embark on an action adventure across floating islands where magical creatures, fast-paced arena battles, and an ever-growing flying base hide a unique twist: every battle is powered by real mathematics, helping you become smarter with every challenge.

title: Escape the Walls Demo
description: You're surrounded by walls. All you have on you is your hands. You have to punch your way through, no other choice.

title: How to Please Your Pussy Demo
Vape Empire Simulator Demo
description: Run your own vape shop for five days. Stock the shelves, set your prices against a moving market, serve customers at the till and grow your reputation. Your shop is saved, so you can carry on from day six in the full game.

title: King of the Mob Demo
description: KOTM is an action-packed, deckbuilding roguelike where a horde of troops is your weapon of choice. Craft an unbeatable deck, swarm and annihilate rival armies, and upgrade your measly militia into a warlord’s legion. Seize the empire and ascend to the throne!

title: TEMPLE BREAKER Demo
description: Play the first four chapters of Temple Breaker free. Breach the Broken Gate, master the Hook Chain and Clay Bombs, and defeat the Scarab Broodmother in this top-down 2D action adventure. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Su Congyi of Pingyuan County Demo
description: In the 4th year of Zhenghe reign of Northern Song, lawsuits spread in Pingyuan County. As a civilian litigator, you take on civil disputes. Examine indictments, gather evidence and testify in court to distinguish truth from falsehood.

title: GOONS! Demo
description: GOONS! is a roguelike auto-battler where you travel through space, building an army of silly little aliens! Discover powerful, game-breaking synergies to take down your foes!

title: The graveyard duty fall of the last demon  Demo
description: THE GRAVEYARD DUTY: FALL OF THE LAST DEMON A cybernetic wave-based FPS. Take Graveyard Duty deep inside a classified facility. Defend the Core from AI drones that want to wipe out humanity. Survive endless waves with bullet multipliers, dash, time stop, and shield

title: Project 14 Demo
description: Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, dark humour and unexpected twists. Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and decide whether to obey or defy a disturbingly polite system. Your actions shape the experience – and may lead to different outcomes.

title: 最后一击 Demo
description: LASTHIT is an original indie game that blends tactical strategy, roguelike elements, and deck-building. As the commander, you defend against monster invasions by positioning your troops and increasing your combat power—striking with the last hit to eliminate enemies before they go berserk.

title: Friendly Pharmacy Demo
description: Clock in for a free taste of Friendly Pharmacy, a slapstick pharmacy game for 1–4 players. Fill questionable prescriptions, handle warehouse deliveries and tackle your first printer jam. Includes the first four campaign missions, solo or in online co-op.

title: Good President Simulator Demo
description: Free demo of Good President Simulator, a satirical political sim played from your desk. Sign laws by hand, drawing the signature yourself. Every law pleases some factions and enrages others, and tomorrow's paper will judge you.

title: All Army Attack Demo
description: Get an exclusive early look at the action in All Army Attack with a brand new demo! Jump straight into the Prologue and brave the Arid Wastes across 6 escalating difficulty levels.

title: I Am Plague Demo
description: I Am Plague is a dark incremental roguelite with automatic combat and permanent progression. Lead a horde of rats, collect mutations, create powerful synergies, and devour your enemies as you climb 200+ floors of a vast underground fortress. Every death makes you stronger.

title: My Little Shadow Demo
description: Try a gentle Windows desktop companion with no time limit. Choose a little daughter, share snacks, play with toys and collect her drawings. Includes everyday companionship and a little home, with separate demo saves.

title: I'm No Gambling God Demo
description: Witness the birth of a new God of Gamblers! A casino sim + strategy-building online co-op game for 1-4 players. Team up, share goals, build synergies, and beat 5-minute floors to win big. Can you become the God of Gamblers?

title: 潦草战争：我只有十块钱预算 Demo
description: Doodle Warfare is a super sketchy incremental auto-battler with dead-simple gameplay. Pick your units, hit battle, and upgrade. It somehow even has PvP. You can also draw your own custom units and battle against other players. Please play this game, I'm begging you (seriously, please).

title: Pizzarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Shop Demo
Starship Duel Demo
description: Try Starship Duel, an asynchronous PvP auto battler. Build your starship, combine modules and connect unique ports to create powerful synergies. Challenge builds created by other players at your own pace, with a shipgirl by your side.

title: One More Siege Demo
description: One More Siege is an Incremental Strategy game with massive auto-battling armies. Plan your building placement to counter the enemy, break their ranks and destroy their castle. Every battle earns you Honor, which you can spend to upgrade your army.

title: Souls End Demo
description: Souls End is an auto-battler roguelike where you'll draft unstoppable armies, placing units and items in just the right way to create awesome synergies! Cast spells while battles unfold and find relics to further elevate builds. Will you defeat life itself-or will you meet a Souls End?

title: UNCRACKED Demo
description: Get a taste of UNCRACKED, a fast-paced 2D action adventure where eggs fight with guns, kicks and whatever else they can throw. Crack your way through selected story missions or survive waves of enemy Eggons in Arena mode. Expect shattering shells, splattering yolk, and plenty of egg-splosive chaos!

title: ClickCrafter Demo
description: A dark cozy incremental crafting game about reclaiming yourself while marooned on a mysterious island. Click, craft, collect, construct and restore your way back to humanity while uncovering the island’s secret history. But beware — is the island guiding you home, or does it have other plans?

title: Forester Demo
description: Atmospheric forest management game about rebuilding a neglected woodland estate, mastering the care of the land, and finding your place among its inhabitants. Plant, cut and cultivate trees, restore your homestead, and shape the life of the one who tends it.

title: Rogue Fantasy: The Ever-Shifting Worlds Demo
description: A seamless blend of JRPG depth, roguelike unpredictability, and auto-battler strategy. Recruit heroes, forge powerful synergies, and fight to survive in ever-shifting realms. The journey never ends… will you be the one to shape its fate?

title: Colonials Demo
description: We respect your time, so in demo you can find multiple maps, units and enemies to explore and defeat. Good luck!

title: Dragon's Tear Demo
description: Slay monsters, harvest their Tears and power-up your party in this idle dungeon crawler RPG. Farm cleared floors while AFK, then leap back into action to lead your party down 100 handcrafted floors. Can you find the legendary Dragon's Tear?

title: Boopie Island Demo
description: Build a cozy village for your Boopies! Keep them happy with swings, flowers, and plenty of cozy surprises. Assign professions to them and enjoy watching your village grow.

title: Minesheeper Demo
description: Play as a sheep in this cozy 3D remake of Minesweeper, the classic logic puzzle game. Frolic around and munch through grass, but be careful--there are mines ahoof! Use the numbers on the ground to deduce which spots are safe to eat.

title: A Game About Digging For Worms Demo
description: Free demo! Grab a shovel and dig your garden 15 meters deep. Catch 4 kinds of worms, sell them to the old sailor and finish the quest: 200 worms — your reward is 60 seconds of LASER EYES! Play solo or online co-op with friends. Costs just one donut 🍩 — with way more holes!

title: The King's Muster Demo
description: The whole first Mark of The King's Muster: thirty battles on the Meadow, from the first skirmish to a siege at the gates of the Mark's castle, plus the sandbox with up to 2,000 men. Your campaign carries over to the full game.

title: The President Goes Live Demo
description: In this absurd physics comedy set in a fictional world, control the President’s hands, get the work done, manage stress and the global threat level, and keep the livestream going until midnight as chaos escalates.

title: 地下城：提灯人 Demo
description: Dungeon: Lanternbearer is a RPG built around loot and buildcraft. Take up your lantern and delve into dungeons lost to the Dark Erosion. Slay monsters, gather loot, and combine Arts and gear into your own build. Recover memories of your sister A-Ning and bring her home before the world forgets her.

title: Mercenary Galactic Demo
description: Synergize your fleet and fight your way toward the notorious Blackstar! Mercenary Galactic is a starship autobattler featuring rogue-lite elements and powerful fleet customization. Upgrade, recruit, and optimize your way through the Velle galaxy and beyond.

title: 怪兽对战大师 Demo
description: Monster Battle Master is a character adventure game focused on creature collecting. You'll start by getting a unique field mouse and gradually embark on your own new adventure, challenge all the strong enemies in the region with your senior sister, and relive past memories along the journey.
developer: 超巨大战喵, 都有做游戏

title: ZombieTrain Demo
description: Zombie Train is a roguelite survival defense game. Fight endless zombie hordes, defend your base camp, and cooperate or compete with other survivors. Combine weapons and cards to build your ultimate armored train. Every choice matters!

title: More Minions Demo
description: 100% hand-drawn by me! More Minions Demo is a fantasy roguelike autobattler. Explore an illustrated overworld, recruit and equip units, and arrange small army cards for automatic battles. Choose rewards, adapt to casualties, and experiment with tactical item cards and mid-battle repositioning.

title: Orbital Outbreak Demo
description: A fast-paced action roguelite shooter set on spherical planets. Fight hordes of enemies on curved surfaces, extract resources, and push deeper into a fractured void where time and space are unstable. Master diverse weapons, build powerful synergies, and uncover the mystery at the heart of the void.

title: Crimson Ocean Demo
description: Pilot an upgradeable combat boat against swarms of alien harvesting machines in this top-down naval action game. Dodge ramming hulls, unleash guns, missiles, and torpedoes, and turn wreckage into firepower. To them, you’re raw material.

title: Lost In Socks Demo
description: The washing machine exploded and socks are everywhere! Grab, throw, wash and pair your way through a chaotic physics-based laundry adventure. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op. Try the Small House for free!

title: Unclean Hands Demo
description: Free demo of Unclean Hands: one night in the bathhouse — the Bannik and the Kikimora. Play Durak against cheating spirits, alone or online with a friend. Catch them red-handed or lose a finger.

title: Eras Showdown Demo
description: An auto-battler where the shop doesn't sell a single weapon. It sells materials — Stone Age to far future — and you forge the rest. Line up eight units, gear them, and send them against the saved formations of real players. Ten wins take the run. Ten losses end it.

title: Sincerely, Your Diary Demo
description: A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town. The soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside, and your favorite tracks playing in your headphones. A simple "hi" from a stranger breaks the quiet. What starts as a chat to pass the time becomes a fragile thread connecting two very different worlds...

title: AI面接官を突破せよ Demo
description: 履歴書に「幽霊」「前世」「土下座」!? 指定された変なワードを全部入れて履歴書を書き、AI面接官の審査を突破せよ。質問はあなたの履歴書からAIがその場で考える。言い訳とこじつけで採用をもぎ取る、おバカ就活ゲーム。

title: Land Reclamation Demo
description: Build a path across the sea, one stone at a time. In this free first-person incremental demo, throw rocks, earn points and grow stronger on a realistic coast. Try stone skipping, lift giant rocks and progress toward Mountain Lift or Super Leap.

title: SCRAP CROWN Demo
description: The first two acts of SCRAP CROWN, free. Rip the weapons off every gang you beat, bolt them onto your robots, crown one of them, and fight through the junkyard and the smelter to the Derailed Knight. The robots you wreck leave wreckage behind, and it makes your next run stronger.

title: Neural Spaceship Sandbox Demo
description: Neural Spaceship Sandbox is a hybrid turn-based strategy and voxel sandbox with unlimited possibilities. Build custom spaceships, arm them to the teeth with advanced sci-fi weaponry, pilot them or hand the keys to our advanced AI, and then use them to conquer the galaxy / galaxies!

title: Starwisp Hyperdrive Demo
description: A cozy sci-fi life sim where you play as a spaceship captain piloting your Shufflewing through a whimsical universe with your cat and robot crew member. Keep your hyperdrive fueled, stock up on food, and maintain the ship's machinery. Mine resources, analyse samples, print parts and more!

title: Two & Two: Agents Demo
description: Become a secret-agent duo in a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Investigate a strange experiment, exchange clues across different perspectives, and talk your way through puzzles neither agent can solve alone.

title: All You Can Reap Demo
description: A short incremental game about feeding a Demonic Altar by reaping squirming field of Critters. Reap, grow, and slowly descend into hell!

title: Midnight Yakiniku | 深夜焼肉 Demo
description: A psychological horror game set in a yakiniku restaurant in Japan. As the owner, you open the restaurant and welcome customers as usual. But that night, orders begin arriving from Table 7—a table that shouldn't exist...

title: 漢字でポン! 合体漢字パズルゲーム Demo
Low Level Hunters Demo
description: Low Level Hunters is a low-poly, cold war era helicopter combat flight simulator. Pilot Cobra attack helicopter, Huey II utility helicopter, or MD-500 Defender by directly interacting with switches and control devices using mouse, jouysticks, and VR controllers to defeat ruthless rebels!

title: Panning Out Demo
description: Free demo! Pan a sleepy creek for gold, melt it down at your forge and craft rings, coins and crowns for your village. Panning Out is a cozy gold rush: no hurry, no stress, just the joy of a nugget glinting in your pan.

title: Goldgrave Demo
description: An incremental auto-battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero to slay hordes and loot gear. Pick a class with its own attack style and learn its skills. Gear up, sweep the gold and descend against floors of enemies, bosses and legendary drops.

title: Daydream Drifters Demo
description: A roguelike stealth horror where dungeons, enemies, and items are procedurally generated. With dynamic events over time and changing weather, hide from enemies with distinct abilities—or prepare to fight. Explore 3 seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream.

title: World of Two Worlds Demo
description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric journey between worlds ✨ Having lost your memory, you set out on a path of self-discovery: transform into animals, explore philosophical parables, and seek a legendary artifact capable of bestowing true enlightenment and revealing every facet of the universe 🌿

title: Containment Shift Company Demo
description: A 1–10 player co-op horror management demo. Care for supernatural creatures, turn their materials into goods, and deal with breaches together. Share bugs and feedback to help improve the game.

title: Doll Brawl Demo
description: A demo for Doll Brawl, a character action roguelike. Battle enemies, and find different abilities to change your playstyle! Upgrade abilities in the skill tree to control the flow of your build, and take down increasingly tougher enemies with those upgrades!

title: Alt-Tab Legend Demo
description: Ever seen that guy at the internet café running eight games at once? Your turn. Build the PC, set up the keyboard, raise a few Keysprites to mash keys for you, and open more games every night. The demo covers the whole café; everything after you walk out a winner is in the full game!

title: Crossfire Demo
description: Crossfire 2D — a crazy 2D action where every wall is deadly. Ricochets, ragdoll physics, and paranoia. Survive the chaos of multiplayer battles!

title: DEEP FORTRESS Demo
description: Play the first sector of DEEP FORTRESS for free. Build war machines part by part, launch them from your fortress, and break through the Salvage Yard's three operations and its commander in a single-player tactical autobattler.

title: Desecrated Demo
description: Play though the first 2 levels.

title: Magnet Salvage: Road to Orbit Demo
description: The demo of Magnet Salvage: Road to Orbit. Swing a giant electromagnet and rip hundreds of pieces of scrap out of the desert. Grow your magnet and solar panels, pay the lease bills, and pull your sunken spaceship out of the quicksand section by section. Play until you lift the large cargo pod.

title: Dream Delver Demo
description: Start your first shift in Dream Delver, a cozy-but-eerie 2D mining adventure. Dig through four zones, sell your haul, forge better tools and survive your bosses’ terrible advice as you descend toward the strange glow of the Sunken Aquifer.

title: 赛勒帝国：遗迹 Demo
description: Explore the forest ruins in this single-player deckbuilding demo. Follow branching paths, use cards, relics and potions in turn-based battles, and weigh your choices at shops and story events. Plan each turn to survive the challenges ahead.

title: Turn&Boost Demo
description: The demo has the practice run and the two class C cups - six of the full game's nine courses.Your progress in the demo carries over to the full game.

title: Stillwater: Coastal Maine Demo
description: Spend a summer evening at an old captain’s house on the Maine coast. Explore the house and shore, fish from the dock, and collect sea glass as daylight fades into blue hour. Stay as long as you like.

title: Purrfect Hand Demo
description: Make your own luck in this cozy poker incremental demo. Play the opening chapter of Purrfect Hand: trim your deck, buy upgrades, unlock Second Look, and meet a mischievous cat through playful challenges at a cozy card table.

title: Emory Cole &  The Secret at Greymar Point Demo
description: A cozy, point & click first-person detective adventure where you explore a Pacific Northwest coastal town, talk to quirky townies, solve layered puzzles, investigate clues, and uncover a century-old secret.

title: Undrift Demo
description: Try all of Undrift for seven days.Undrift filters thumbstick drift for VRChat through SteamVR. Adjust the filters for movement, rotation and your action menus, see the stick input before and after filtering, and use the app in a floating VR window.This demo has the same features as the full version.

title: Hundred Metres Back Demo
description: Kellsport, 1999. When a bag nobody owns turns up, everyone moves a hundred metres back, except you. From a police van full of switches and CRT monitors, drive a clumsy bomb-disposal robot to it, X-ray it, read what is inside and make it safe. Get it wrong, and the CCTV shows you why.

title: Drop That Pen Demo
description: The demo includes two pens, the Blockus board and the first two grades. Everything you earn in it carries over to the full game.

title: Dragon's Keep: Tidy up the Treasure! Demo
Heart of Ural Demo
description: Heart of Ural is a pixel rhythm RPG based on the ancient epic Ural-Batyr and Bashkir myths. This is a deep story with many difficult decisions and unexpected twists, humor and drama. In this game, EVERYONE remembers what you did before.

title: Idle War Legion: WW2 Demo
description: Recruit soldiers, tanks, artillery and planes into an auto-battling WW2 army of up to 10 slots. Upgrade it and set the formation; it fights on while you're away, or in a desktop mini window as you work. Face 14 themed Bosses, the Infinite Cyber War Tower, 20 vs 20 Grand Army Battles and more.

title: 추 : 그날의 악몽 Demo
description: Demo of CHU: The Nightmare of That Day. Long after your discharge, you wake up back in the barracks: live through Day 1 and the first night with “him” still awake, then take on spin-off Chapter 1, The Silent Monastery, in 1-4 player online co-op. The full game launches January 14, 2027.

title: Unfinished Demo
description: An abandoned commercial building. A forgotten incident. Something lurking in the ruins. Uncover the truth and escape in this first-person survival horror.

title: Single File Demo
description: A pixel-art auto-battler. An old master and his three students march down the road in single file and fight on their own. The one in front takes the blows, and the fallen walk to the back. You tap the spells, and Spirit doesn't refill by itself. Win or lose, the gold grows the dojo's skill tree.

title: A Wizard-Chess Tournament Demo
description: Chess, but with wizards. Every piece has HP and Attack and spell cards bend the rules. Outplay a friend in hotseat, over LAN, or online and climb the leaderboard.

title: Bring Me More! Demo
description: A dark fantasy roguelike auto-battler where massive armies clash as rival gods shape your campaign with blessings, curses, and impossible demands.

title: FROSTVAULT Demo
description: Play the opening of FROSTVAULT for free: chip and melt blocks of ice to free the treasures frozen inside, sell them or keep them on your shelf, upgrade your cozy glacier workshop, rescue Kartopu the cat and open the Big Door. About 25 minutes of play.

title: Ancient World Demo
description: Try the Ancient World demo, a story-driven survival adventure set in an open desert. Gather resources, craft tools, explore ancient ruins, fight goblins, and begin your search for your missing sister in a world full of danger and mystery.

title: Mortal Cultivators: Idle Companions Demo
description: A desktop companion idle cultivation RPG. Build a squad, fight automatically, collect treasure chests, and tune techniques and gear. Explore two maps with 18 standard nodes and two bosses, reach rank 19, and keep playing without a time limit.

title: Last Haul Demo
description: Haul cargo across a dying world in an armed semi. Trade between the last survivor cities, bolt guns onto your trailer, rescue stragglers and blast through alien swarms and rival factions. Every run reshapes the road, and any run could be your last haul.

title: $1 Pizza Slice Demo
description: Try ten days in a cozy New York pizza shop where every slice costs $1. Roll dough, prepare toppings, bake and cut pizzas, then serve hungry neighbors. Shop for ingredients, upgrade your kitchen, share leftovers, and chip away at your debt.

title: Luna Plena Demo
description: "Read your enemy. Count every turn." A Short RPG Beneath the Full Moon.

title: Learn To Rock - Học Cách Chơi Nhạc Rock (Demo)
description: Learn To Rock – Học Cách Chơi Rock is an indie game developed by Trịnh Productions. The game is a mix of Adventure, Action, Rhythm, Simulation, and is set in Vietnam 2026. Playing as Trịnh, players will practice, overcome various challenges and recruit new members to complete his rock band.

title: 一撇 One Stroke Short Demo
Project Babel Demo
developer: Shenzhen XOBOX Cultural Creative Co., Ltd.

title: Hold On! Let Me Level Up! Demo
Nine Legion Demo
description: Lead three heroes into random dungeons in this pixel-art action game. Switch heroes as AI allies fight beside you. Earn gold, upgrade skills and defeat bosses to recruit companions. Play three chapters in this demo, then build a nine-hero legion in the full game and face Endless Mode!

title: FaceRobots Demo
description: Try FaceRobots for free! Chaotic 1-4 player co-op with ragdoll physics: tiny robots wearing your live webcam as a face. Smash trash and suitcases, sell the loot and take down the first two bosses: a dumpster that swallows players and a giant spider on roller skates.

title: Boss, I Crashed! - Depot Tycoon Demo
description: You run a depot. Your drivers run into everything else. Ship pallets across a 3D tabletop map, manage drivers with too many excuses, outplay a rival depot and watch your own disasters on the evening news. Then read the Z report and cry.

title: Outgrowing Wake Demo
description: Grow a civilisation across a persistent galaxy that keeps running while you are away. Research, colonise and automate your worlds, make peace and trade with rival empires, and reach beyond your cradle.

title: We Are The Wall Demo
description: The public demo of "We Are The Wall" is out now! You can play it for free and get a taste for the game.

title: Helio-3 The Lab Demo
description: Helio-3 is a laboratory incremental game combining idle progression, atom merging, and physics. This demo offers the base game experience limited to 5 runs—approximately 30 minutes to one hour of gameplay, depending on your pace.Play with atoms of different colors: make them collide, split them through fission, and fuse them together.

title: Dungelo Demo
description: [b]One dungeon, three heroes.[/b]The Dungelo demo is a single fixed dungeon: five floors and the Warden waiting at the bottom. It's the same dungeon every time, so you can learn it, then try it again as the Knight, the Rogue or the Mage.[list][*]A full run takes about 15 minutes.[*]Plays offline, no account needed.

title: Sinesperia Demo
description: Someone lived a life here. You just can't remember it yet. Explore the dreams buried deep inside your mind to find out who you were.

title: Frogging Up: Frog Climb Rage Game Demo
Overbuffed Demo
description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder with auto-battler combat. Build your deck, summon creatures, upgrade your weapon, and fight your way through floors filled with ever-deadlier enemies. Every run is different. Every mistake can be fatal.

title: Lucky Castaway Demo
description: In this roguelike deckbuilder you are stranded with a slot machine! Gather resources, craft items and create game-breaking synergies to survive against all odds!

title: Mamka Said Demo
description: Free demo. Dru is back in her old room, and Mamka is there to take care of everything. Then Dru meets Bib... Why does this little girl keep waiting for permission? Mamka, she can answer for herself, can't she?

title: Lugh World Demo
description: A living world awaits new explorers. Capture creatures called Lughs, evolve your team, and face epic challenges in real-time combat. In Lugh World, your adventure is shaped by the choices you make, the Lughs you encounter, and the challenges you decide to overcome in an ever-evolving world.

title: DEFY Demo
description: Play the opening of DEFY's story from either side: the Meridian Concord or the Ashpact Horde. Ten training drills, the first three missions of each campaign, villages that hide or fight back, and a world worth fighting over.

title: Dirt Town Demo
description: The demo for Dirt Town. Use incredible physics to create a road to find sand: Fell tree, move rocks, haul gravel! Find the hidden vehicle and build a jump!

title: Dead on Delivery Demo
description: Dead on Delivery is a top-down action roguelite where you deliver pizzas in the middle of zombie hordes. Pick up orders and deliver them before customers give up, combine cards to create insane builds, and spend your tips on bizarre weapons, katanas, and permanent upgrades.

title: Spexl Demo
description: Spexl is an incremental game where you destroy planets made of pixels and collect every particle they’re made of to upgrade your ship. Fly, shoot, and get back to base before you run out of fuel. The challenge is to push farther and farther out.

title: Your Desktop Companion - Lumi Demo
description: Introducing Lumi: an AI that lives on your desktop.Lumi is a fully animated 3D AI companion who stays with you while you work, browse, play games, listen to music or just chill out.Instead of being a typical chatbot stuck in a browser window, Lumi is an interactive character who lives right on your Windows desktop.

title: Rites of Thaw Demo
description: A Slavic-folklore auto battler. Draft Leshy, Strzyga and Domovoi from a shared pool and lead them through a year of rites: festivals you see coming, gifts that cost a sacrifice, shrines on the board. See your next opponent before you set your board. No timer, no queue. Four of the six lands.

title: The Factory Must Fall Demo
description: Build the perfect factory, then let it go to war! Draft buildings from a randomized shop, optimize resource allocation and army composition, then watch your factory crush your enemies in this automation autobattler!

title: À Deriva Demo
description: The À Deriva demo: a fisherman who lives on your taskbar and fishes on his own while you work. It has the Araguaia and the Rio Negro, the boats up to the Speedboat and the first three rods. It also runs as a wallpaper.

title: Sticker Shop Cozy Idle Demo
description: Catch drifting sticker packs, decide which ones to open or sell, and discover cute, rare, and foil stickers. Create new designs at your drawing table, complete your collection, hire assistants, and grow a tiny convention stand into a bustling three-counter shop.

title: Kill the AI Demo
description: Survive 10 minutes against rogue AI, build your loadout, choose one weapon transfiguration and take down the Tensor Core Sentinel. Then keep the run going in Endless mode. A complete, replayable slice of Kill the AI. Wishlist Kill the AI to support the full game, Thanks!

title: Alice: Defense Demo
description: Recruit heroes, build your team, and face waves of monsters in the Alice: Defense demo. Try a portion of the full game's battles and experiment with your team composition. We're working hard to make the game more fun.

title: One More Medal: Sports Life Sim Demo
description: Try five sports in this pixel sports life sim: 100 m, 800 m, pole vault, javelin and weightlifting. Choose talents, train and shape your athlete’s life. Career progression is unrestricted, from childhood through the international stage and retirement.

title: Tavern Clicker Demo
description: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

title: Stem The Tide Demo
description: Try the free demo of Stem The Tide, a hybrid auto-battler and roguelite. Build your camp, recruit and merge units, combine Peasants, Order, Chaos and Technology into powerful synergies, and hold the last bastion against procedurally generated waves of the Swarm!

title: Fruit Auto Fighters Demo
description: In this auto battler, every fruit on your team is slowly rotting. Draft a squad, arm them with weapons, and compost the spoiled ones into fertilizer for whoever's left. Then send them out to fight teams built by real players.

title: Sort The Plushie Store Demo
description: Welcome to your new job at the coziest, most chaotic plushie store! Sort 400 out of 4000 adorable plushies, unlock quirky vending-machine buffs, and sort alt-universe variants in this satisfying, physics-based organization game.

title: Travelling to Woolokii Demo
description: Solve cases, investigate mysteries, and explore the Island of Woolok in this chapter-based Point & Click / Visual Novel.

title: Drift Scrappers Demo
description: Build a crew of space scavengers in this sci-fi roguelite autobattler. Recruit scrappers, gear them up, set your formation, and watch the tactical chaos play out!

title: Dwarven Digging Machine Demo
description: Command dwarves as they build a huge dwarven digging machine. Harvest resources, find powerful artifacts, defend against your foes and conquer the underground in this incremental strategy game.

title: Oh No, Meteor! Demo
description: Oh No, Meteor! is a short incremental game. Chop trees with your cursor, send lumberjacks, haulers, and miners to work, then spend wood, stone, and coins on a huge skill tree, talent cards, and artifacts before the meteor hits the town.

title: One More Rock! Demo
description: A chill incremental game about satisfying mining and automated forging. Mine. Gamble. Upgrade. Repeat. Mine another rock while the lantern is burning.

title: The Crown Must Endure Demo
description: Rule a medieval kingdom where every decision has a consequence. Settle disputes, manage scarce resources, and defend your castle against invading armies. Your choices shape who stands beside you, who betrays you, and how your reign will be remembered.

title: Still Pines: watchtower Demo
description: Explore a snow-covered forest, investigate an isolated watchtower, restore failing equipment, and uncover unsettling clues in this atmospheric first-person psychological horror demo. As darkness falls, every sound leaves you wondering what might be lurking among the trees.

title: FlipFight Demo
description: Try FlipFight in a free 10-minute PvE demo. Play the Assassin in Stage 1, choose combat upgrades, and explore the redesigned sanctuary lobby. Retry with a fresh start; demo progress stays separate from the full game.

title: Last Ward Demo
description: Fight back the horde as the Warden in this free Last Ward demo. Explore the corrupted Breachwood, build your skills and gear, and return to the Refuge between runs.

title: QSO7 Demo
description: A space RPG with an insanely rich story line filled with mind-bending puzzles, beautiful weapons with plenty of particle effects, deep philosophical conversations and gorgeous alien species. The game is more like a sci-fi visual novel with action elements.

title: The Curse of Ooty Demo
description: You drove her from the city to Ooty. Something followed her into the car. Now she is possessed, and an aghori in the hills will only help if you bring him what he asks for. First-person Indian folk horror.

title: Pixelborn Demo
description: The free demo of Pixelborn: dive into THE DEEP and cross DUNE SEA. Lead glowing pixel monsters into giant clams, falling anchors and chains of mines, fire a shipwreck's cannon into the horde, and face the Mantis Shrimp, the Kraken and the Dune Wyrm. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Slovian Salvation Demo
description: Slovian Salvation is a first-person survival horror game inspired by Slavic folklore. Explore a dark forest, uncover the secrets of an old mine, and face creatures from folk tales. Gather supplies and guard your sanity—before you can no longer tell reality from nightmare.

title: Tongyou Town Demo
description: A town that runs itself. You decide who ventures out, where they go, and what the town sells. Recruit, form squads, farm regions, craft gear, and run the market — the rest happens without you.

title: Until You're Empty Demo
description: A fast-paced action platformer set in a vertical arena. Dash, leap and slash through waves of enemies and deadly bosses. Manage your stamina carefully: every jump and sword strike costs you, and one mistake can leave you running on empty. One hit is all it takes to die.

title: A Kingdom of Soil Demo
description: Return to a medieval borderland. Rebuild from a hoe, forge, hunt, and reclaim your tavern amid faction conflicts. Words sway deals, cooking wins hearts, choices shape your legacy. Live your legend in an open world.

title: Slots & Slaughter Demo
description: You're a broke gladiator whose entire kit is locked inside a slot machine. Spin to gear up, gamble on the reroll, and win your freedom. Or die a legend who gambled it all away.

title: The Last God Demo
description: Play the first two pantheons of The Last God: the Pagan and Norse realms, six gods to bring down, two classes to master, and Nightmare for those who survive it.

title: Creator Tycoon Demo
description: Try the early stages of studio management in Creator Tycoon Demo for free. Combine production cards to design workflows, furnish your workspace, and develop your team in a management sim about building your own creator company.

title: 倘若你想见到明天 Demo
Clanker Town Demo
description: Play rings 1 and 2 of Clanker Town free. Defend your trailer, build up from a nail gun, beat Mega-Roomba, then face the Fridge Mothership in a night fight. Then take your own guns into a 100,000-robot sneak peek you can't win.

title: Coin Frenzy Demo
description: Coin Frenzy is an incremental game about launching coins and growing your rewards. Upgrade coin values, launch more coins, and boost your sectors. Earn skill points, rebirth into the skill tree, and unlock new ways to fill and collect your board

title: Bio Inc. Total Defense Demo
description: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

title: Death Denied Demo
description: Death Denied is a brutal, fast-paced top-down action game focusing on skull-crushing close combat in medieval England. Every encounter is an unforgiving deadly dance. Break walls, bones and necks. Strike with precision. Embrace divine blessings that modify the way you fight.

title: Human-powered world Demo
description: An incremental game with a light tone and humor. Develop your colony, discover resources, build production, and unlock upgrades. Turn a lifeless planet into a thriving world and watch it transform step by step.

title: Deport Me to Your Bed Demo
Nebulagon Demo
description: Pick Elly, Crunk, Monk or Boo for a 2v2 arena bout. Fight beside an AI teammate in Solo or hand a friend a controller for same-screen co-op. A guided tutorial with English text and pre-recorded voices teaches you the controls.

title: Hushwell Demo
description: The demo of an atmospheric 2D metroidvania that leads ever deeper. Leap, dash and cling to walls through the root-choked Rootways and the drowned Glowmire, push back creatures with pulses of echo, and face two bosses that each fight in their own way.

title: Remember Us Demo
description: “Who are you?” The most painful question one could hear at the end of a fifty-year love story. *Remember Us* is an emotional journey you embark on to bring back every memory Dean has forgotten and to help him remember his wife once again.

title: Request Stop Demo
description: This is a separate story that ties in to the full game. A seaside town out of season: early shifts, the bus to work, a neighbour nobody has seen for a while. What you do here carries on into the full game.

title: 网瘾猫猫 Demo
description: Demo — Battery running low! Place the cats and route their cables with care to charge every device and keep these internet-loving kitties exploring the digital world!

title: Odd Rock Out Demo
description: One cozy afternoon, five thousand pebbles, and no idea where you left the key. Pick them up, shake them by your ear, and get delightfully distracted. Try the first 35 minutes of Odd Rock Out, alone or in online co-op with up to four friends.

title: 斗域经理 Demo
description: Arena Manager is a club management game focused on hero development, team building, and automatic battles.In this demo, recruit and develop heroes, combine classes, skills, and equipment, and arrange your lineup and formation to compete in tournaments.

title: Abyss Outpost: Auto Frontline Demo
description: A roguelite auto-battler. As an explorer, venture into the perilous abyss to collect bio-data and print unit cards. Equip gear and tactical modules, build your frontline, auto-summon massive armies, survive brutal boss assaults, crush fortified enemy lines, and forge an immortal legend!

title: MODULE:BERSERK (모듈 버서크) Demo
description: MODULE:BERSERK is a 2D pixel "hard-boiled" action game with steampunk-inspired world of endless desertification and corruption. Play as a butler-styled automaton. Track down the suspect that caused terrifying event to the family you serve. And protect the only survivor, 'lady' from upcoming dangers.

title: Together, Against Mork Demo
description: Slay the hordes, build smart defenses, and protect The Crystal at all costs. Together, Against Mork is a fast-paced single-player game that combines action-roguelike combat with tower-defense strategy. With every weapon, every hero, every defense—against Mork.

title: Bloomtop Demo
description: A cozy idle gardening game that lives at the bottom of your desktop. Water, harvest and cross-pollinate pixel-art plants while you work, discover 70+ hybrids, and grow a flowering vine up your monitor's edges until it frames your whole screen.

title: Amazing Sumo Boat Adventure Demo
description: You are a sumo warrior in a boat. You are trying to climb to the top of the mountain by attaching ropes to the environment. Gameplay based on using only two buttons

title: 萌宠满桌：一大群爱撒娇的治愈系桌面宠物 Demo
description: Clingy cats and dogs move onto your desktop to keep you company while you work. Collect 72 pets and 26 rare furniture pieces, including 16 secret mixes born only from love. Run a pet kitchen and adopt strays. So thoughtful: even when you're too busy to respond, they grow fonder of you every day.

title: Wheel Wills Demo
description: A roguelike where every attack is a gamble. Spin the Wheel to decide what each day throws at you, fill your grid with Gambits that either hit or miss, and repaint the Wheel itself to bend the odds your way

title: Tungsteel Demo
description: Build deadly mech squads in a single-player autobattler with a turn-based strategy map. Combine abilities, set target priorities, and cut enemy supply lines. Capture resources to repair, rearm, and unlock new mechs as you push toward the enemy base.

title: Heroes Guard: Starforge Demo
description: Design your warships, pick the pilots who fly them, then watch the battle play out. Starforge is an auto-battler with personality: voiced pilots with their own moves, moods, and limits. The demo includes the full first and and the SUPPLY RUN mode.

title: DEMO - The Myth of Might: A Lone Wolf
Arctic Shop Simulator Demo
description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

title: Sogni d'Oro Demo
description: Sogni d'Oro is a Japanese-style RPG with an Italian flavour.

title: Dead Week Demo
description: Play the first three days of Dead Week!Expect a lot of dialog and some short combat, with Deb's first nights as the Reaper of Marrowgate, and very important decisions to make.Your progress carries over: if you buy the game, your demo save continues in Early Access.

title: Off Grid Pop Demo
description: Pop cats, dodge dogs, and prove a bayou grandpa is human in five increasingly absurd captcha tests. Mind Otis's glasses, feed Hushpuppy, and choose a room view or a bigger TV. Play with mouse or gamepad in this free Act I demo.

title: Spotlight Tennis Demo
description: Spotlight Tennis Demo is a dynamic classic tennis game. Sharpen your skills, play to win, and become a champion!

title: 桌游时间 Demo
description: I't Table Time Demo is out! Play 10 classics: Dou Dizhu, Hold'em, Blackjack, Solitaire, Xiangqi, Chess, Gomoku, Yacht Dice, Mastermind & Minesweeper. Features solo play, multi-level AI, local pass-and-play, visual rules, profiles & auto-save. Try it free, share feedback & wishlist the full game!

title: Mighty Mini Golf Demo
description: Mighty Mini Golf is a wild mini golf adventure! Golf through the first world in this demo, including a single 18 hole course, a mini game, and boss fight! Also try out 1 on 1 multiplayer locally or online via Remote Play Together.

title: The Orphaned House Teaser Demo
description: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

title: Refill Demo
description: Play the first three chapters of Refill. Pour, sort, and fill a pill organizer week after week as one woman's life unfolds through the notes and packages that arrive. About 40 minutes. No timers, no pressure.

title: Crazy Farm Demo
description: A relaxing yet chaotic farming roguelike. Combine quirky animals, items, and strategic layouts to create explosive, poop-powered chain reactions!

title: GraviSmack Demo
description: Bend gravity, skate across impossible surfaces, and smash through swarms in GraviSmack, a movement-driven action roguelite. Build a wild mix of weapons and boons, unlock new characters, and fight solo or with friends.

title: Poppets & Plunder Demo
description: A pirate roguelite deckbuilder. You are the ship’s witch: play curse cards, pin the doll, and order the crew while the guns fire in real time. The demo covers the Reefs, with two captains, two hulls and a fight against Commodore Pryce.

title: ROOM 307 Demo
description: Return to an abandoned psychiatric hospital where your mother vanished twenty years ago. Explore dark corridors, solve environmental puzzles, and survive terrifying encounters in this 25–30 minute first-person psychological horror demo. Room 307 is waiting.

title: Only Arms: Grab, Sometimes Fall Demo
description: Try the first climb for free: the full sea-cliff course from the shore to the summit flag. The full game will be more than four times longer.

title: Nothing Unusual Demo
description: Nothing Unusual is a light backpack-building arena survival roguelike. The city’s gone weird; monsters are crawling out of the cracks. Fight with sticks, thermoses, umbrellas and odder things: arrange, merge and mix elements in your backpack, and last until dark. After all, monsters need sleep too.

description: Try the free demo. You are the Dark Lord, and heroes have left your dungeon in chaos. Pick up objects, gather matching ones and find where they belong in this first-person organizing simulator. Add the full game to your wishlist.

description: In this bizarre, darkly comedic murder mystery set in 1990s Japan, you play as private investigator Naomi Ishigura. Investigate a murder, get to know an eccentric cast of characters, and take on a series of increasingly absurd challenges.
